notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for the official IEEE 1516.1 timestamped default-region attribute mixed-fanout surface. The source uses only the standard C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, endpoint, callback configuration, and logical-time implementation. It verifies delivery splitting between immediate and constrained regional recipients, supplied-empty source-region metadata, delivered-copy Request Retraction, pending-copy suppression, and federation cleanup without asserting provider-specific behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador timestamped default-region attribute publication and subscription with FederateAmbassador reflection, retraction, and grant callbacks
